events.title: Podcasting 101
events.location: The Edge Digital Media Lab, South Brisbane
events.description: A hands-on introductory workshop at The Edge focusing on the technical and creative foundations of podcast production. You will learn the basics of recording, editing, and storytelling in a collaborative community space.

events.title: Fragile and Forever: Ceramics from the Queensland Museum Collection
events.description: An ongoing exhibition showcasing delicate ceramic works, offering an intimate look at historical craftsmanship and design evolution. It is a quiet, contemplative space perfect for those interested in material culture and history.

events.title: Stories You Wear: Magpie Goose
events.location: Museum of Brisbane, Brisbane City Hall
events.description: An exhibition exploring the intersection of textiles, storytelling, and contemporary Indigenous Australian fashion. It highlights the creative labor and cultural significance behind locally produced wearable art.

events.title: Brisbane Sculpture Festival (Sculptors Queensland)
events.location: Brisbane Botanic Gardens Mt Coot-tha, Toowong
events.source: Sculptors Queensland / Brisbane Botanic Gardens Mt Coot-tha
events.description: A widespread outdoor exhibition featuring large-scale sculptural works set within the lush environment of the Mt Coot-tha Botanic Gardens. It is an ideal space for a thoughtful, quiet walk among art and nature.

events.title: California Lane CD & Record Fair (BIGSOUND)
events.description: A community-focused gathering for music enthusiasts and collectors during the BIGSOUND festival period. It offers a relaxed atmosphere for discovery and conversation among local vinyl and music culture fans.

events.title: KOREABOO
events.source: La Boite Theatre / Griffin Theatre Company
events.description: An experimental theatre production by Chloe Kim that explores the complexities of identity, fandom, and cultural obsession in the age of K-pop. This is a bold, contemporary work likely to provoke conversation about modern subcultures.

events.title: Ballet Foundations
events.description: A structured, beginner-friendly course in ballet technique held at a professional dance facility. It is designed for adults looking to build movement skills in an authentic and disciplined creative environment.

events.title: QYO Solo! (Young Composer Program showcase)
events.description: An intimate showcase of original works composed by young, emerging musicians participating in the QYO Young Composer Program. It provides an inspiring look at the next generation of experimental musical composition.
